item.title: Full Pacific Four Series schedule unveiled with fixtures heading to Sacramento, Kansas City and Chicago
item.description: World Rugby confirms the full Pacific Four Series 2026 schedule that will see USA host Australia, Canada and New Zealand with matches across three straight weekends in April.

item.title: World Rugby launches Women in Rugby Careers Programme for 2026
item.description: World Rugby has launched the Women in Rugby Careers Programme, reinforcing its ongoing commitment to strengthening leadership and career pathways for women across the global game.

item.title: HSBC SVNS 2: 12 teams set out on HSBC SVNS World Championship quest in Nairobi
item.description: Teams have landed in Nairobi ahead of the opening round of HSBC SVNS 2 this weekend, 14 and 15 February, at Nyayo National Stadium

item.title: Kenya, USA and Argentina lead HSBC SVNS 2 pack in Nairobi
item.description: Argentina’s women and men’s sides USA and Kenya all unbeaten on day one of the inaugural HSBC SVNS 2 competition in Nairobi in front of a sell-out crowd in full party mode at Nyayo National Stadium.

item.title: Argentina and Germany take the lead in HSBC SVNS 2 race with Nairobi wins
item.description: Promoted HSBC SVNS 3 women’s champions Argentina and Germany claim HSBC SVNS 2 gold in Kenya and lead the way in the race to the HSBC SVNS World Championship Series.

item.title: World Rugby confirms Emirates Match Official appointments for Guinness Women’s Six Nations and Pacific Four Series 2026
item.description: Aimee Barrett-Theron will become the second female to referee 50 tests after the appointments were announced for the Guinness Women’s Six Nations, Pacific Four Series and the inaugural U21 Women’s Six Nations Series.

item.title: FEEL THE ENERGY IN VALLADOLID
item.description: The World SVNS Series lands at Estadio José Zorrilla for three epic days of world-class rugby. Watch the game’s biggest stars go head-to-head in the fast, fearless and unmissable SVNS format.
